topic: Adding reach graph to real-time panel
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the technical feasibility of replacing the current percentage bar in the real-time analytics panel with a graph, specifically for 'Reach' data. It was confirmed that this feature is technically possible. The plan involves integrating Reach data and adjusting time zone handling to use local company/facility time instead of UTC. Furthermore, it was established that the necessary data will be accessible via both API and S3.
decisions: The real-time panel will incorporate a graph for Reach data.
Reach data integration will utilize local facility time zone settings rather than UTC.
Data access will be provided through both API and S3.
action_items: Design mockups incorporating the Reach graph are due by Monday (assigned to someone).
Finalization of demo materials is required between Monday and Tuesday.
